long_biography.plain_text:
Palmer Johnson owner Timur Mohamed built an earlier career as a left-handed cricketer, representing Guyana and playing county cricket for Suffolk. As a teenage captain, he led Guyana to the regional youth championship in 1975, scoring centuries in both innings of the final against Barbados. His first-class career extended over a decade.

His business interests also included founding Noble House Seafoods, a Guyanese company that continued supporting local cricket under later ownership. Mohamed maintained a connection with his birthplace after his playing career ended. During the pandemic, he donated 10,000 masks to Guyana's Ministry of Education as it prepared for schools to reopen.
